Visitor returns rendered heading template as bare string; mixed-case is preserved (regression guard for issue #350)

```elixir title="Elixir"
visitor = %{
      :handle_heading => fn(args) ->
        {:custom, "\#\# " <> Map.get(args, "text", "") <> " \#\#"}
      end,
    }

result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<h2>Important Section Title</h2><p>Body.</p>", %{visitor: visitor})
IO.inspect(result)
```
